# Ledger: a tiny expense tracker for small restaurants

Built by Maya. Python 3 standard library server + vanilla JS front end.
Staff log daily expenses by category; the owner sees weekly totals and a
simple over-budget warning. No dependencies.

Run: python3 server.py  then open http://localhost:8000
